scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted a housing loan application for a conventional loan to purchase a home. Can you please tell me the status or outcome of my application?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional home purchase loan has been approved and the loan has been originated. If you have any additional questions about your loan details, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know! That’s great to hear. Can you tell me what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of the loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.869%. The total costs associated with your loan are $17,758.29. If you have any questions about these figures or need more details, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thanks for the information. Are there any high-cost (HOEPA) flags or negative amortization features on my loan? And has my loan so far been sold or transferred to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features. After origination, your loan was sold to Fannie Mae. If you need clarification on any of these points, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you, that answers my questions. Can you also tell me what my debt-to-income (DTI) ratio was for this application, and what it means for my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio for this application was 49%. DTI represents the percentage of your total monthly debt payments compared to your total monthly income used to qualify for the loan. The record does not include specific information about how this ratio affected your loan terms.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for explaining that and answering all my questions clearly. I appreciate how you provided the information and addressed each of my concerns.

<Satisfied>  
I’m satisfied with this interaction because the agent answered all my questions promptly, shared all of the details available in the record, and communicated in a clear and professional way. I feel confident that I understand the outcome and the key details about my loan.
